findings: CommandFactoryNoteOnEntity.executeInternal resolves Quark<Entity>.getData without restricting leaf kind. Rust try_note searches entity_by_path and package_by_path only. The preserved Java-valid note_peer is rejected with unknown note target: M.

The Java bracket-note grammar permits stereotype, tags and URL before the brace. Rust ATTACHED_ML_RE omits these; stereo_brace succeeds through the wrong Description fallback and loses the class/note model. This is model loss despite CLI exit zero.

push_note materializes phantom packages before the named note. qualified_reopen retains objects but reverses the note/group UIDs and retains the implicit group's source line instead of the explicit package command. Named quark existence and entity materialization need separate ordering.
nested_brace correctly retains entity Fake and end note as text and keeps one record plus two notes. Its remote-reference geometry still differs; that comparison is not waived.
bounded_repair_guidance: Resolve every materialized quark kind through one ownership model; consume the full note modifier grammar; separate quark creation from group materialization and source attribution.

source_audit.scope: Full continuation production diff inspected; named Java/source mechanisms checked; no fixture-shaped branches or shipping fixture data observed. No baseline/comparator/frozen-rule edits.
